Name: Custom Crafting Stations
Author: CherryChain
Description:
Lets mod authors add custom crafting stations which open menus with a limited selection of recipes, optionally hiding those recipes from the vanilla crafting menus.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]How to use (for players)[/size][/b]
This mod does nothing on its own. Just install this mod, and it'll work automatically for any mod that uses it.

You can optionally use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure whether crafting stations pull ingredient from nearby chests, the fridge, and/or all chests.

[b][size=5]How to use (for mod authors)[/size][/b]
See the [url=https://github.com/ChroniclerCherry/stardew-valley-mods/tree/develop/CustomCraftingStations#readme]technical documentation[/url].

Some features you can use:
[list]
[*]Custom crafting menus which can contain crafting or cooking recipes.
[*]Custom crafting menus can be opened from a specified bigcraftable item (like a custom workstation object) or through a map tile property.
[*]Recipes in the custom menus can optionally be removed from vanilla menus, so you can add large numbers of new recipes without crowding the existing menus.
[/list]

[b][size=5]Common questions[/size][/b]
[quote][size=3][b]Is the mod still compatible?[/b][/size]
The mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Does the mod conflict with any others?[/b][/size]
There are no known mod conflicts. Feel free to report compatibility issues in the mod comments.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Can I safely add/remove the mod anytime?[/b][/size]
Yep. The mod doesn't make any permanent changes to the save, though you may need to remove mods that use it too when removing it.[/quote]
